# HP OMEN MAX 16-ak0012nb — SRC-0278

## Source

https://www.hp.com/be-nl/shop/products/laptops/hp-omen-16-gaming-laptop-16-ak0012nb-shadow-black-qhd-rtx-5080-azerty-toetsenbord-met-rgb-verlichting-per-toets-bp1n2ea-uug/

HP Belgium lists the exact Belgian AZERTY SKU at €2499 including VAT and nearly sold out. The same page offers a three-year pickup-and-return Care Pack for €69.99. Exact specs include Ryzen AI 9 HX 375, RTX 5080 16GB, 32GB as 2x16GB, 1TB, two M.2, two 40Gbps USB-C/USB4, two USB-A and 2.5GbE. The matte 500-nit IPS panel is explicitly only 100% sRGB, so the otherwise exceptional €2568.99 support-adjusted transaction fails Laptop B's full-P3 gate.
